purpose: Read-only diagnosis after frozen predictions and final evaluation; no fitting or new prediction execution.
independent_evaluation_unit: Passage family; paired variants, clauses, and repeats are not independent observations.
scope: Generated English passages; fixed grade-six profile; prediction of Jev-derived estimates.

definitions.metric_weighting: Mean across steps within each family, then equal family weights.
definitions.stable_reference: All three complete repeat scores are identical.
definitions.focus_endpoint: Reading step containing the end of the uniquely matched predeclared focus text.
definitions.last_step: Final reading step of the complete passage; exploratory when extending a focus expectation.
definitions.peak: Maximum of the per-step median reference scores or displayed predictions over the complete passage; exploratory.
definitions.repeat_delta_range: Minimum and maximum across observed cross-variant repeat combinations; not a confidence interval.
definitions.missing_pairs: Incomplete reference families are excluded from endpoint/peak directional comparisons; their available steps remain in general error diagnostics.
definitions.worst_examples: Up to eight stable-reference errors per model, at most two per family; selected for diagnosis, not prevalence estimation.

strongest_next_test.specific_repair_to_test: Preserve ordered actor/action/object roles and explicit links to previously introduced object identities in the local measurements.
strongest_next_test.design: New withheld matched pairs controlling wording and length; old and newly opened cases become development material. Freeze the repaired and comparator procedures before obtaining answers.
strongest_next_test.measurement_audit: Separately inspect the reference procedure's bounded earlier-candidate selection in near/far pairs; do not attribute these reference-score reversals to human memory.
strongest_next_test.criterion: Retain the predeclared 0.10 family-weighted MAE improvement target and appropriately adjusted family-level interval.
strongest_next_test.scope: Repairs within authorized approaches 1–3 only; no passage-type formula routing or additional language model.

limitations: Counterexamples test these frozen procedures and their scoped magnitude predictions, not the possibility of every future equation.
Stable Jev repetition does not establish human cognitive truth; unstable references are reported, not automatically blamed for equation errors.

Approach 3 stores sorted argument identity sets in relation keys. Reversing who follows whom can therefore collapse into one relation identity. This demonstrates lost role information, not by itself an incorrect final numerical count.

Any approach-2 advantage is evidence about the implemented intermediate-prediction procedure. It is not a clean causal demonstration that one cognitive mechanism was isolated; measurements, learned proxies, and counting rules differ.

Paired expectations were tentative and alternatives were documented. Reference outcomes opposing an expected direction challenge that expectation for these counts, not the observed data or human-memory theory.
All examples are authored under one reference profile; family resampling does not establish transportability across authors, readers, or natural educational corpora.

old_development_exact_collisions.exact_comparison: Python tuple equality of all 30 exported float feature values; no binning, rounding, approximation or feature selection.
old_development_exact_collisions.logical_scope: If two identical complete feature vectors have different reference targets, no deterministic function of only that vector can exactly match both. This constrains this input representation, not equations using other text measurements, and does not establish human working-memory truth.
old_development_exact_collisions.bound_scope: This is an exact mathematical constraint on deterministic functions of the frozen complete 30-value vector for these 389 fixed stable labels. It is an unweighted sample bound, not a population or family-weighted bound. The bound does not rule out 95% agreement, other inputs, or the broader possibility of an equation.
